events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh today as it did 57 years ago. What's your go-to track from The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking after all these years with The Pretenders. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrating his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment or song?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in 1975.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and hope that still resonates today. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed music listening forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film premiere in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Shaken, not stirred... What's your all-time favourite Bond film or iconic theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of comedy icon John Cleese, who turns 87 today.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of The Beatles' sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. Which track from its diverse collection stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His incredible stage presence and vocal range continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal moment in their evolving sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
